name: Ms. Detective - File #2: Sugatanaki Irainin
original_name: ミス・ディテクティヴ　ファイル#2　姿なき依頼人
source:
Akane feels bad lately and following her friend advice she goes to a hot springs resort. But on the way there she sees a white ghost...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-october-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
茜最近状态不佳。在朋友的建议下，她前往温泉度假村，却在途中看见了一个白色的幽灵……

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-october-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
